`state/SponsorProvider.tsx`:

```tsx
// Decides once for the whole app whether sponsored cards may render: only after auth has hydrated and Pro
// status is known, and only for a user who is not Pro (a guest never is). While Pro status loads or after
// it fails, every card stays hidden, so a Pro user never sees a card flash (Review Focus 6). Outside the
// provider every card is hidden too, which keeps screens rendered without providers (and their tests)
// free of cards. Mounted inside AuthProvider in app/_layout.tsx.
import { createContext, useContext, useMemo, type ReactNode } from 'react';

import { useAuth } from './AuthProvider';
import { type ProStatusState, useProStatus } from './useProStatus';

export type SponsorEligibility = 'eligible' | 'hidden';

type SponsorContextValue = { eligibility: SponsorEligibility };

const HIDDEN: SponsorContextValue = { eligibility: 'hidden' };
const SponsorContext = createContext<SponsorContextValue>(HIDDEN);

export function readSponsorEligibility(proStatus: ProStatusState, isAuthHydrated: boolean): SponsorEligibility {
  if (!isAuthHydrated) return 'hidden';
  if (proStatus.status === 'guest') return 'eligible';
  if (proStatus.status === 'ready' && !proStatus.isPro) return 'eligible';
  return 'hidden';
}

export function SponsorProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const proStatus = useProStatus();
  const { isHydrated } = useAuth();
  const eligibility = readSponsorEligibility(proStatus, isHydrated);
  const value = useMemo<SponsorContextValue>(() => ({ eligibility }), [eligibility]);
  return <SponsorContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</SponsorContext.Provider>;
}

export function useSponsor(): SponsorContextValue {
  return useContext(SponsorContext);
}
```

`components/sponsor/useSponsorContent.ts`:

```ts
// The content one sponsored card shows and its two analytics reports. Hidden unless SponsorProvider allows
// cards; otherwise the house card (a direct sponsor replaces it in Task 6.10). A feed that renders its own
// ad (AdMob, EthicalAds) passes its source to onShown and onClicked. ad_shown and the host's onHostShown
// (the results cadence) run once per mount, whatever the card shows first; ad_clicked runs on every press.
import { useCallback, useRef } from 'react';

import { trackEvent } from '../../clients/analyticsClient';
import { HOUSE_CARD } from '../../constants/sponsor';
import type { SponsorContent, SponsorSource } from '../../services/sponsor/types/SponsorContent';
import type { SponsorPlacement } from '../../services/sponsor/types/SponsorPlacement';
import { useSponsor } from '../../state/SponsorProvider';

export type SponsorContentState = {
  content: SponsorContent | null;
  onClicked: (source?: SponsorSource) => void;
  onShown: (source?: SponsorSource) => void;
  status: 'hidden' | 'ready';
};

export function useSponsorContent(placement: SponsorPlacement, onHostShown?: () => void): SponsorContentState {
  const { eligibility } = useSponsor();
  const hasReportedShown = useRef(false);
  const hostShownRef = useRef(onHostShown);
  hostShownRef.current = onHostShown;
  const content = eligibility === 'eligible' ? HOUSE_CARD : null;
  const contentSource = content?.source ?? HOUSE_CARD.source;

  const onShown = useCallback(
    (source: SponsorSource = contentSource) => {
      if (hasReportedShown.current) return;
      hasReportedShown.current = true;
      trackEvent('ad_shown', { placement, source });
      hostShownRef.current?.();
    },
    [contentSource, placement],
  );

  const onClicked = useCallback(
    (source: SponsorSource = contentSource) => trackEvent('ad_clicked', { placement, source }),
    [contentSource, placement],
  );

  return { content, onClicked, onShown, status: content === null ? 'hidden' : 'ready' };
}
```

```tsx
// Hosts the Pro sheet the house card opens (source house_card), next to the card, so no screen that shows
// a card has to host it. A signed-in user gets area 4's ProOffer, the same buy flow as Settings and
// Ask (its messages, the pending re-check, the web redirect to /purchase-complete). ProOffer serves no
// guest, so a guest gets the bare sheet with no prices (usePurchases has none for a guest either), and its
// Buy sends them to sign in and back to this route.
import { router, usePathname } from 'expo-router';

import { useSignedInUserId } from '../../state/AuthProvider';
import { ProOffer } from '../purchase/ProOffer';
import { ProSheet } from '../purchase/ProSheet';

const GUEST_PRICES: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {};

export function SponsorProSheetHost({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) {
  const userId = useSignedInUserId();
  const pathname = usePathname();

  function sendGuestToSignIn() {
    onClose();
    router.push({ params: { returnTo: pathname }, pathname: '/sign-in' });
  }

  if (userId !== null) return <ProOffer onClose={onClose} source="house_card" />;
  return (
    <ProSheet
      isBuying={false}
      message={null}
      onBuy={sendGuestToSignIn}
      onClose={onClose}
      prices={GUEST_PRICES}
      source="house_card"
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
// The house or direct sponsor card, used by every feed's fallback: it reports ad_shown once after it
// first renders, and its button reports ad_clicked and then opens the Pro sheet (house card) or the
// sponsor's https link (direct sponsor).
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { Linking } from 'react-native';

import { SponsorContentCard } from './SponsoredCardFrame';
import { SponsorProSheetHost } from './SponsorProSheetHost';
import type { SponsorContentState } from './useSponsorContent';

export function SponsorContentSlot({ sponsor }: { sponsor: SponsorContentState }) {
  const { content, onClicked, onShown } = sponsor;
  const [isSheetOpen, setIsSheetOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (content !== null) onShown(content.source);
  }, [content, onShown]);

  if (content === null) return null;

  function handlePress() {
    if (content === null) return;
    onClicked(content.source);
    if (content.source === 'house') setIsSheetOpen(true);
    else if (content.href !== undefined) void Linking.openURL(content.href);
  }

  return (
    <>
      <SponsorContentCard content={content} onPress={handlePress} />
      {isSheetOpen ? <SponsorProSheetHost onClose={() => setIsSheetOpen(false)} /> : null}
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// The sponsored card on iOS and Android (the web build uses SponsoredCard.web.tsx). Renders nothing unless
// SponsorProvider allows cards; otherwise the house card or a direct sponsor. onShown tells the host the
// card was shown, once (the results screen counts it toward the cadence).
import type { SponsorPlacement } from '../../services/sponsor/types/SponsorPlacement';
import { useSponsor } from '../../state/SponsorProvider';

import { SponsorContentSlot } from './SponsorContentSlot';
import { useSponsorContent } from './useSponsorContent';

export type SponsoredCardProps = { onShown?: () => void; placement: SponsorPlacement };

function SponsoredCardBody({ onShown, placement }: SponsoredCardProps) {
  const sponsor = useSponsorContent(placement, onShown);
  return <SponsorContentSlot sponsor={sponsor} />;
}

export function SponsoredCard(props: SponsoredCardProps) {
  const { eligibility } = useSponsor();
  if (eligibility === 'hidden') return null;
  return <SponsoredCardBody {...props} />;
}
```

### Task 6.5: the results card cadence counters

**Files:**

- Create: `services/sponsor/sponsorCadence.ts`
- Test: `services/sponsor/__tests__/sponsorCadence.test.ts` (new)

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes: `readStoredJson` (`clients/readStoredJson.ts:20`, returns `{ isReadFailed, value }`), `writeJson` (`clients/writeJson.ts:7`), `SPONSOR`, `SPONSOR_CADENCE_STORAGE_KEY`. The counters mirror the stats storage: one JSON value in AsyncStorage, a failed read never overwritten (`services/stats/resolveStoredStats.ts`, `state/StatsProvider.tsx:170-183`).
- Produces: `type SponsorCadence = { completedRounds: number; roundsSinceLastCard: number }`; `shouldShowResultsCard(cadence: SponsorCadence): boolean`; `recordRoundCompleted(): Promise<SponsorCadence | null>` (null when the stored value could not be read; nothing is written then); `recordCardShown(): Promise<void>` (sets `roundsSinceLastCard` to 0). All writes run through one module-level queue.
- Rule (the cadence): every finished round with at least one question adds 1 to both counters, whatever its kind (`bank` or `review`) and whether or not the user is Pro; a round with no questions adds nothing. Only a `bank` round's results screen may show the card, so a review round counts toward the counters but never shows a card, and when a card falls due on a review round the next `bank` round shows it. Only a card that rendered resets `roundsSinceLastCard`. With `MIN_ROUNDS_BEFORE_FIRST: 2` and `ROUNDS_BETWEEN: 3` the first card lands on round 3, matching the device check. Task 6.6 applies the rule in `useResultsSponsorSlot`.

`services/sponsor/sponsorCadence.ts`:

```ts
// The results screen's sponsored card cadence, kept on the device beside the stats: rounds completed, and
// rounds completed since the last card. A card is due once the device has completed
// SPONSOR.MIN_ROUNDS_BEFORE_FIRST rounds and SPONSOR.ROUNDS_BETWEEN rounds have passed since the last card
// (or since the first launch), so with 2 and 3 the first card lands on the third round's results and then
// every third round. A stored value that is not a cadence counts from zero; a read that fails changes
// nothing and shows no card, so a storage fault never shows extra cards. Every change runs through one
// queue, so two rounds recorded together never lose a count.
import { readStoredJson } from '../../clients/readStoredJson';
import { writeJson } from '../../clients/writeJson';
import { SPONSOR, SPONSOR_CADENCE_STORAGE_KEY } from '../../constants/appConfig';

export type SponsorCadence = { completedRounds: number; roundsSinceLastCard: number };

const EMPTY: SponsorCadence = { completedRounds: 0, roundsSinceLastCard: 0 };

let queue: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();

function isCount(value: unknown): value is number {
  return Number.isInteger(value) && (value as number) >= 0;
}

function toCadence(value: unknown): SponsorCadence {
  const { completedRounds, roundsSinceLastCard } = (value ?? {}) as Partial<Record<keyof SponsorCadence, unknown>>;
  if (Array.isArray(value) || !isCount(completedRounds) || !isCount(roundsSinceLastCard)) return EMPTY;
  return { completedRounds, roundsSinceLastCard };
}

function enqueue<T>(task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const run = queue.then(task);
  queue = run.catch(() => undefined);
  return run;
}

// Reads, folds, and writes one change; null (and no write) when the read failed.
function changeCadence(fold: (current: SponsorCadence) => SponsorCadence): Promise<SponsorCadence | null> {
  return enqueue(async () => {
    const read = await readStoredJson(SPONSOR_CADENCE_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (read.isReadFailed) return null;
    const next = fold(toCadence(read.value));
    await writeJson(SPONSOR_CADENCE_STORAGE_KEY, next);
    return next;
  });
}

export function shouldShowResultsCard({ completedRounds, roundsSinceLastCard }: SponsorCadence): boolean {
  return completedRounds >= SPONSOR.MIN_ROUNDS_BEFORE_FIRST && roundsSinceLastCard >= SPONSOR.ROUNDS_BETWEEN;
}

export function recordRoundCompleted(): Promise<SponsorCadence | null> {
  return changeCadence(({ completedRounds, roundsSinceLastCard }) => ({
    completedRounds: completedRounds + 1,
    roundsSinceLastCard: roundsSinceLastCard + 1,
  }));
}

export async function recordCardShown(): Promise<void> {
  await changeCadence((current) => ({ ...current, roundsSinceLastCard: 0 }));
}
```

`state/useResultsSponsorSlot.ts`:

```ts
// Counts a finished round toward the sponsored card cadence once per results screen and says whether the
// results card is due. A review round counts but never shows a card; an empty round is not counted. The
// answer arrives after the storage write, and nothing is set once the screen has unmounted.
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import { recordCardShown, recordRoundCompleted, shouldShowResultsCard } from '../services/sponsor/sponsorCadence';

import type { RoundKind } from './useQuizEngine';

type ResultsSponsorSlotArgs = { roundKind: RoundKind; totalQuestions: number };

export function useResultsSponsorSlot({ roundKind, totalQuestions }: ResultsSponsorSlotArgs) {
  const [isCardDue, setIsCardDue] = useState(false);
  const isMounted = useRef(true);
  const hasRecorded = useRef(false);
  const hasMarkedShown = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMounted.current = true;
    return () => {
      isMounted.current = false;
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (hasRecorded.current || totalQuestions === 0) return;
    hasRecorded.current = true;
    void recordRoundCompleted().then((cadence) => {
      if (!isMounted.current || cadence === null || roundKind === 'review') return;
      if (shouldShowResultsCard(cadence)) setIsCardDue(true);
    });
  }, [roundKind, totalQuestions]);

  const markCardShown = useCallback(() => {
    if (hasMarkedShown.current) return;
    hasMarkedShown.current = true;
    void recordCardShown();
  }, []);

  return { isCardDue, markCardShown };
}
```

```ts
// The direct sponsor in content/sponsor.json: card text, an https link, an optional icon under content/,
// and the first and last day (inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD) it shows.
export type Sponsor = {
  headline: string;
  body: string;
  href: string;
  iconPath?: string;
  startsOn: string;
  endsOn: string;
};
```

`packages/content-schema/src/validateSponsor.ts`:

```ts
// Validates content/sponsor.json for the content build and the app. Returns the typed sponsor, or the first
// rule it broke. Dates are not compared with today here: an expired sponsor is valid and the app skips it.
import { CONTENT_LIMITS } from './contentLimits.js';
import { isHttpsUrl } from './isHttpsUrl.js';
import { isRecord } from './isRecord.js';
import { isTextWithin } from './isTextWithin.js';
import type { Sponsor } from './types/Sponsor.js';

type SponsorResult = { isValid: true; sponsor: Sponsor } | { isValid: false; rule: string };

const ALLOWED_KEYS: readonly string[] = ['body', 'endsOn', 'headline', 'href', 'iconPath', 'startsOn'];
const ICON_PATH = /^[a-z0-9-]+(\/[a-z0-9-]+)*\.(png|webp)$/;
const ISO_DATE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;

function isCalendarDate(value: unknown): value is string {
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !ISO_DATE.test(value)) return false;
  const parsed = new Date(`${value}T00:00:00Z`);
  return !Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) && parsed.toISOString().startsWith(value);
}

function findSponsorProblem(input: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
  const unknownKey = Object.keys(input).find((key) => !ALLOWED_KEYS.includes(key));
  if (unknownKey !== undefined) return `${unknownKey} is not allowed`;
  const { body, endsOn, headline, href, iconPath, startsOn } = input;
  if (!isTextWithin(headline, CONTENT_LIMITS.displayFieldLength)) return 'headline is invalid';
  if (!isTextWithin(body, CONTENT_LIMITS.displayFieldLength)) return 'body is invalid';
  if (!isHttpsUrl(href)) return 'href is invalid';
  if (iconPath !== undefined && (typeof iconPath !== 'string' || !ICON_PATH.test(iconPath))) {
    return 'iconPath is invalid';
  }
  if (!isCalendarDate(startsOn)) return 'startsOn is invalid';
  if (!isCalendarDate(endsOn)) return 'endsOn is invalid';
  if (endsOn < startsOn) return 'endsOn is before startsOn';
  return null;
}

export function validateSponsor(input: unknown): SponsorResult {
  if (!isRecord(input)) return { isValid: false, rule: 'root shape is invalid' };
  const rule = findSponsorProblem(input);
  if (rule) return { isValid: false, rule };
  return { isValid: true, sponsor: input as unknown as Sponsor };
}
```

(`isRecord` must reject arrays; it does if it checks `!Array.isArray`. If it does not, add `|| Array.isArray(input)` to the root check.)

```js
// content/sponsor.json is optional. When present it must be a valid direct sponsor within the size limit;
// an expired sponsor still builds, since the app skips it at run time. It is not hashed or bundled: the app
// fetches it from the content base URL, and the web build copies content/ as it is.
async function assertValidSponsor(contentDir) {
  const sponsorPath = join(contentDir, 'sponsor.json');
  if (!(await isFilePresent(sponsorPath))) return;
  const bytes = await readFile(sponsorPath);
  if (bytes.length > CONTENT_LIMITS.sponsorBytes) {
    throw new Error(`sponsor.json is over the ${CONTENT_LIMITS.sponsorBytes} byte limit`);
  }
  let data;
  try {
    data = JSON.parse(bytes.toString('utf8'));
  } catch {
    throw new Error('sponsor.json is invalid: not JSON');
  }
  const result = validateSponsor(data);
  if (!result.isValid) throw new Error(`sponsor.json is invalid: ${result.rule}`);
}
```

```ts
// services/sponsor/__tests__/loadDirectSponsor.test.ts
// The direct sponsor is fetched from sponsor.json under the content base URL and cached without a hash. It
// shows only between its start and end dates, inclusive (Review Focus 10: an expired sponsor shows the
// house card); a missing file clears the cache, a malformed one reads as none, and a network failure falls
// back to the cached copy.
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';

import { CONTENT_CACHE_KEYS } from '../../../constants/contentCacheKeys';
import { CONTENT_BASE_URL, stubFetchRoutes } from '../../content/__tests__/fixtures/contentFixtures';
import { loadDirectSponsor } from '../loadDirectSponsor';

const SPONSOR_URL = `${CONTENT_BASE_URL}sponsor.json`;
const SPONSOR = {
  body: 'Managed Postgres with branching for every pull request.',
  endsOn: '2026-11-30',
  headline: 'Neon',
  href: 'https://neon.tech',
  iconPath: 'sponsor/neon.png',
  startsOn: '2026-11-01',
};
const EXPECTED = {
  body: SPONSOR.body,
  callToAction: 'Learn more',
  headline: 'Neon',
  href: 'https://neon.tech',
  iconUri: `${CONTENT_BASE_URL}sponsor/neon.png`,
  source: 'direct',
};

function serveSponsor(body: unknown) {
  return stubFetchRoutes({
    [SPONSOR_URL]: () => Promise.resolve(typeof body === 'string' ? body : JSON.stringify(body)),
  });
}

function serveStatus(status: number) {
  global.fetch = jest.fn((url: unknown) =>
    Promise.resolve({
      headers: { get: () => null },
      ok: false,
      redirected: false,
      status,
      text: () => Promise.resolve(''),
      url: String(url),
    }),
  ) as unknown as typeof fetch;
}

function failNetwork() {
  global.fetch = jest.fn(() => Promise.reject(new TypeError('Network request failed'))) as unknown as typeof fetch;
}

let warn: jest.SpyInstance;

beforeEach(async () => {
  await AsyncStorage.clear();
  warn = jest.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => undefined);
});

afterEach(() => warn.mockRestore());

describe('loadDirectSponsor', () => {
  it('returns the sponsor as card content within its dates, and caches it', async () => {
    serveSponsor(SPONSOR);
    expect(await loadDirectSponsor(CONTENT_BASE_URL, '2026-11-15')).toEqual(EXPECTED);
    expect(JSON.parse((await AsyncStorage.getItem(CONTENT_CACHE_KEYS.sponsor)) ?? 'null')).toEqual(SPONSOR);
  });

  it('includes the first and the last day', async () => {
    serveSponsor(SPONSOR);
    expect(await loadDirectSponsor(CONTENT_BASE_URL, '2026-11-01')).toEqual(EXPECTED);
    expect(await loadDirectSponsor(CONTENT_BASE_URL, '2026-11-30')).toEqual(EXPECTED);
  });

  it.each([
    ['the day after it ended', '2026-12-01'],
    ['the day before it starts', '2026-10-31'],
  ])('returns null on %s', async (_name, today) => {
    serveSponsor(SPONSOR);
    expect(await loadDirectSponsor(CONTENT_BASE_URL, today)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('leaves out the icon when the sponsor has none', async () => {
    const { iconPath: _icon, ...withoutIcon } = SPONSOR;
    serveSponsor(withoutIcon);
    const { iconUri: _uri, ...expected } = EXPECTED;
    expect(await loadDirectSponsor(CONTENT_BASE_URL, '2026-11-15')).toEqual(expected);
  });

  it.each([
    ['text that is not JSON', '{ headline'],
    ['a sponsor with an http link', { ...SPONSOR, href: 'http://neon.tech' }],
  ])('returns null for %s', async (_name, body) => {
    serveSponsor(body);
    expect(await loadDirectSponsor(CONTENT_BASE_URL, '2026-11-15')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('returns null and clears the cache when the file is gone', async () => {
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(CONTENT_CACHE_KEYS.sponsor, JSON.stringify(SPONSOR));
    serveStatus(404);
    expect(await loadDirectSponsor(CONTENT_BASE_URL, '2026-11-15')).toBeNull();
    expect(await AsyncStorage.getItem(CONTENT_CACHE_KEYS.sponsor)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('falls back to the cached sponsor offline, still within its dates', async () => {
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(CONTENT_CACHE_KEYS.sponsor, JSON.stringify(SPONSOR));
    failNetwork();
    expect(await loadDirectSponsor(CONTENT_BASE_URL, '2026-11-15')).toEqual(EXPECTED);
    expect(await loadDirectSponsor(CONTENT_BASE_URL, '2026-12-01')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('returns null offline with nothing cached, and with no content base URL makes no request', async () => {
    failNetwork();
    expect(await loadDirectSponsor(CONTENT_BASE_URL, '2026-11-15')).toBeNull();
    const fetchMock = serveSponsor(SPONSOR);
    expect(await loadDirectSponsor(null, '2026-11-15')).toBeNull();
    expect(fetchMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

```ts
// The direct sponsor file under the content base URL, its button label, and how long a fetched copy is fresh.
export const DIRECT_SPONSOR_PATH = 'sponsor.json';
export const DIRECT_SPONSOR_CALL_TO_ACTION = 'Learn more';
export const DIRECT_SPONSOR_STALE_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000;
```

`services/sponsor/loadDirectSponsor.ts`:

```ts
// The direct sponsor from sponsor.json under the content base URL, as card content, or null. The file is
// fetched like a bank and cached on the device without a hash (the manifest does not list it and it holds
// no questions). A non-2xx answer means there is no sponsor and clears the cache; a network failure or
// timeout falls back to the cached copy. A malformed file, or a date outside startsOn..endsOn (inclusive,
// the device's local date), reads as null, so an expired sponsor shows the house card (Review Focus 10).
// Never throws.
import { CONTENT_LIMITS, validateSponsor, type Sponsor } from '@syntactical/content-schema';

import { ContentFetchError } from '../../clients/ContentFetchError';
import { fetchContentText } from '../../clients/fetchContentText';
import { logWarning } from '../../clients/logClient';
import { readJson } from '../../clients/readJson';
import { removeStoredKey } from '../../clients/removeStoredKey';
import { writeJson } from '../../clients/writeJson';
import { CONTENT_CACHE_KEYS } from '../../constants/contentCacheKeys';
import { DIRECT_SPONSOR_CALL_TO_ACTION, DIRECT_SPONSOR_PATH } from '../../constants/sponsor';

import type { SponsorContent } from './types/SponsorContent';

function parseJson(text: string): unknown {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

async function readCachedSponsor(): Promise<Sponsor | null> {
  const result = validateSponsor(await readJson<unknown>(CONTENT_CACHE_KEYS.sponsor, null));
  return result.isValid ? result.sponsor : null;
}

async function fetchSponsor(contentBaseUrl: string): Promise<Sponsor | null> {
  let text: string;
  try {
    text = await fetchContentText(new URL(DIRECT_SPONSOR_PATH, contentBaseUrl).toString(), CONTENT_LIMITS.sponsorBytes);
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof ContentFetchError && err.reason === 'status') {
      await removeStoredKey(CONTENT_CACHE_KEYS.sponsor);
      return null;
    }
    logWarning({ err }, 'direct sponsor fetch failed, using the cached copy');
    return readCachedSponsor();
  }
  const result = validateSponsor(parseJson(text));
  if (!result.isValid) {
    logWarning({ rule: result.rule }, 'direct sponsor rejected');
    return null;
  }
  await writeJson(CONTENT_CACHE_KEYS.sponsor, result.sponsor);
  return result.sponsor;
}

function toSponsorContent(sponsor: Sponsor, contentBaseUrl: string): SponsorContent {
  const { body, headline, href, iconPath } = sponsor;
  const content: SponsorContent = {
    body,
    callToAction: DIRECT_SPONSOR_CALL_TO_ACTION,
    headline,
    href,
    source: 'direct',
  };
  return iconPath === undefined ? content : { ...content, iconUri: new URL(iconPath, contentBaseUrl).toString() };
}

export async function loadDirectSponsor(contentBaseUrl: string | null, today: string): Promise<SponsorContent | null> {
  if (contentBaseUrl === null) return null;
  const sponsor = await fetchSponsor(contentBaseUrl);
  if (sponsor === null || today < sponsor.startsOn || today > sponsor.endsOn) return null;
  return toSponsorContent(sponsor, contentBaseUrl);
}
```

```ts
  });
```

```ts
}
```

```ts
// EthicalAds text placements take the card's colours: global.css sets the --ea- custom properties from the
// same hex values as the surface, signal, and ink tokens in tailwind.config.js.
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';

function readToken(name: string): string {
  const match = new RegExp(`\\b'?${name}'?: '(#[0-9a-f]{6})'`).exec(tailwind);
  if (!match) throw new Error(`token ${name} not found`);
  return match[1];
}

function readProperty(name: string): string | undefined {
  return new RegExp(`${name}:\\s*([^;]+);`).exec(css)?.[1].trim();
}

    expect(readProperty('--ea-color-link')).toBe(readToken('signal'));
    expect(readProperty('--ea-color-link-bold')).toBe(readToken('ink'));
  });

  it('sets the text size to the app small text (text-sm, 14px)', () => {
    expect(readProperty('--ea-font-size')).toBe('14px');
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

`components/sponsor/SponsoredCard.web.tsx`:

```tsx
// The sponsored card on the web (iOS and Android use SponsoredCard.tsx). With an EthicalAds publisher id and
// the client script loaded, the card holds one manual text placement inside the frame: ethicalads.load()
// runs once the placement is in the DOM, and ethicalads.reload() on each later route change while the
// placement stays mounted. The client documents no "no ad" callback, so a placement with no child element 3
// seconds after a load or reload counts as no fill (an assumption checked on the deployed site), and the
// card then shows the direct sponsor or the house card, as it does with no publisher id or no client.
// EthicalAds sets no cookies, so the web asks for no consent.
import { createElement, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import { usePathname } from 'expo-router';

import { readExtraString } from '../../config/readExtraString';
import { ETHICAL_ADS_FILL_TIMEOUT_MS } from '../../constants/sponsor';
import { useSponsor } from '../../state/SponsorProvider';

import type { SponsoredCardProps } from './SponsoredCard';
import { SponsoredCardFrame } from './SponsoredCardFrame';
import { SponsorContentSlot } from './SponsorContentSlot';
import { useSponsorContent, type SponsorContentState } from './useSponsorContent';

type EthicalAdsClient = { load: () => void; reload: () => void };

function readEthicalAdsClient(): EthicalAdsClient | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  const client = (window as { ethicalads?: Partial<EthicalAdsClient> }).ethicalads;
  return typeof client?.load === 'function' && typeof client.reload === 'function'
    ? (client as EthicalAdsClient)
    : null;
}

// The client renders its ad (a .ea-content element) inside the placement; any child element counts.
function hasFill(placement: HTMLElement | null): boolean {
  return placement !== null && placement.childElementCount > 0;
}

type EthicalAdsPlacementProps = {
  client: EthicalAdsClient;
  onEmpty: () => void;
  publisher: string;
  sponsor: SponsorContentState;
};

function EthicalAdsPlacement({ client, onEmpty, publisher, sponsor }: EthicalAdsPlacementProps) {
  const placementRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const loadedPathname = useRef<string | null>(null);
  // Callbacks are read through a ref so a new identity (the direct sponsor arriving) never cancels the
  // pending fill check; the effect depends only on the client and the route.
  const latest = useRef({ onEmpty, onShown: sponsor.onShown });
  latest.current = { onEmpty, onShown: sponsor.onShown };
  const { onClicked } = sponsor;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (loadedPathname.current === pathname) return undefined;
    const isFirstLoad = loadedPathname.current === null;
    loadedPathname.current = pathname;
    if (isFirstLoad) client.load();
    else client.reload();
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (hasFill(placementRef.current)) latest.current.onShown('ethicalads');
      else latest.current.onEmpty();
    }, ETHICAL_ADS_FILL_TIMEOUT_MS);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [client, pathname]);

  return (
    <SponsoredCardFrame headline="EthicalAds">
      {createElement('div', {
        className: 'dark flat',
        'data-ea-manual': 'true',
        'data-ea-publisher': publisher,
        'data-ea-type': 'text',
        onClickCapture: () => onClicked('ethicalads'),
        ref: placementRef,
      })}
    </SponsoredCardFrame>
  );
}

function WebSponsoredCard({ onShown, placement }: SponsoredCardProps) {
  const sponsor = useSponsorContent(placement, onShown);
  const [publisher] = useState(() => readExtraString('ethicalAdsPublisher'));
  const [client] = useState(readEthicalAdsClient);
  const [isEmpty, setIsEmpty] = useState(publisher === null || client === null);
  const markEmpty = useRef(() => setIsEmpty(true)).current;
  if (isEmpty || publisher === null || client === null) return <SponsorContentSlot sponsor={sponsor} />;
  return <EthicalAdsPlacement client={client} onEmpty={markEmpty} publisher={publisher} sponsor={sponsor} />;
}

export function SponsoredCard(props: SponsoredCardProps) {
  const { eligibility } = useSponsor();
  if (eligibility === 'hidden') return null;
  return <WebSponsoredCard {...props} />;
}
```

```ts
] as const;
type AdMobIdName = (typeof APP_ID_NAMES)[number] | (typeof UNIT_ID_NAMES)[number];

// A production EAS build with every id real, then the overrides (undefined removes a variable).
function setProductionBuild(overrides: Partial<Record<AdMobIdName, string | undefined>> = {}): void {
  process.env.EAS_BUILD_PROFILE = 'production';
  const ids: Record<string, string | undefined> = {
    ...Object.fromEntries(APP_ID_NAMES.map((name) => [name, APP_ID])),
    ...Object.fromEntries(UNIT_ID_NAMES.map((name) => [name, UNIT_ID])),
    ...overrides,
  };
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(ids)) {
    if (value === undefined) delete process.env[name];
    else process.env[name] = value;
  }
}

function loadConfig(): ExpoConfig {
  let loaded: ExpoConfig | undefined;
  jest.isolateModules(() => {
    loaded = require('../../app.config').default as ExpoConfig;
  });
  return loaded as ExpoConfig;
}

function readAdMob(): Record<string, unknown> {
  return (loadConfig().extra as { admob: Record<string, unknown> }).admob;
}

function readPluginOptions(): Record<string, unknown> {
  const entry = (loadConfig().plugins ?? []).find(
    (plugin) => Array.isArray(plugin) && plugin[0] === 'react-native-google-mobile-ads',
  ) as [string, Record<string, unknown>] | undefined;
  if (!entry) throw new Error('ads plugin missing');
  return entry[1];
}

function captureError(): Error | null {
  try {
    loadConfig();
  } catch (error) {
    return error as Error;
  }
  return null;
}

beforeEach(() => {
  for (const name of ENV_NAMES) delete process.env[name];
});

afterAll(() => {
  for (const name of ENV_NAMES) {
    if (ORIGINAL[name] === undefined) delete process.env[name];
    else process.env[name] = ORIGINAL[name];
  }
});

describe('app.config AdMob', () => {
  it('falls back to the sample app ids with no unit ids and no test ads', () => {
    expect(readAdMob()).toEqual({
      androidAppId: SAMPLE_ANDROID_APP_ID,

  it('declares the plugin with the app ids, delayed measurement, and the SKAdNetwork list', () => {

    );

  it('carries real app and unit ids', () => {
    process.env.ADMOB_ANDROID_APP_ID = APP_ID;
    process.env.ADMOB_IOS_RESULTS_UNIT_ID = UNIT_ID;

    const admob = readAdMob();
    expect(admob.androidAppId).toBe(APP_ID);
    expect(admob.resultsAdUnitId).toEqual({ android: undefined, ios: UNIT_ID });
    expect(admob.tracksAdUnitId).toEqual({ android: UNIT_ID, ios: undefined });
  });

  it('turns on test ads and keeps the consent debug device only in a test build', () => {
    process.env.ADMOB_CONSENT_DEBUG_DEVICE_ID = '33BE2250B43518CCDA7DE426D04EE231';
    expect(readAdMob().consentDebugDeviceId).toBeUndefined();
    process.env.ADMOB_USE_TEST_IDS = 'true';
    expect(readAdMob()).toEqual(
      expect.objectContaining({ consentDebugDeviceId: '33BE2250B43518CCDA7DE426D04EE231', isTestAds: true }),
    );

  it.each([
    ['ADMOB_ANDROID_APP_ID', UNIT_ID, 'ADMOB_ANDROID_APP_ID must be an AdMob app id'],
    ['ADMOB_IOS_APP_ID', 'pub-1234567890123456~1234567890', 'ADMOB_IOS_APP_ID must be an AdMob app id'],
    ['ADMOB_IOS_RESULTS_UNIT_ID', APP_ID, 'ADMOB_IOS_RESULTS_UNIT_ID must be an AdMob ad unit id'],
    ['ADMOB_ANDROID_TRACKS_UNIT_ID', `${UNIT_ID} `, 'ADMOB_ANDROID_TRACKS_UNIT_ID must be an AdMob ad unit id'],
  ])('refuses a malformed %s without echoing it', (name, value, message) => {
    process.env[name] = value;

describe('app.config AdMob in a production build', () => {

      expect.objectContaining({ androidAppId: SAMPLE_ANDROID_APP_ID, iosAppId: SAMPLE_IOS_APP_ID }),
    );

});
```

```ts
// An AdMob id is public but must have its kind's shape. A production EAS build must carry every id, and
// none may be one of Google's sample or test ids, so a store build never ships them; development, preview,
// and local builds may leave an id unset. Errors name the variable, never the value.
function readAdMobId(envName: string, kind: 'app' | 'ad unit', isProduction: boolean): string | undefined {
  const value = process.env[envName];
  if (value === undefined || value === '') {
    if (isProduction) throw new Error(`${envName} must be set in a production build`);
    return undefined;
  }
  if (!(kind === 'app' ? ADMOB_APP_ID : ADMOB_UNIT_ID).test(value)) {
    throw new Error(`${envName} must be an AdMob ${kind} id`);
  }
  if (isProduction && value.startsWith(ADMOB_GOOGLE_SAMPLE_PUBLISHER)) {
    throw new Error(`${envName} must not be a Google sample or test id in a production build`);
  }
  return value;
}

// A test build (ADMOB_USE_TEST_IDS=true, the development and preview profiles) serves Google's test native
// ads and may force the EEA consent form on one device; any other build requests ads only for its unit ids.
// EAS sets EAS_BUILD_PROFILE; a production build may not serve test ads.
function readAdMobConfig() {
  const isProduction = process.env.EAS_BUILD_PROFILE === 'production';
  const isTestAds = process.env.ADMOB_USE_TEST_IDS === 'true';
  if (isProduction && isTestAds) throw new Error('ADMOB_USE_TEST_IDS must not be true in a production build');
  const debugDevice = process.env.ADMOB_CONSENT_DEBUG_DEVICE_ID;
  const hasDebugDevice = isTestAds && debugDevice !== undefined && CONSENT_DEBUG_DEVICE_ID.test(debugDevice);
  return {
    androidAppId: readAdMobId('ADMOB_ANDROID_APP_ID', 'app', isProduction) ?? ADMOB_SAMPLE_APP_IDS.android,
    iosAppId: readAdMobId('ADMOB_IOS_APP_ID', 'app', isProduction) ?? ADMOB_SAMPLE_APP_IDS.ios,
    isTestAds,
    ...(hasDebugDevice ? { consentDebugDeviceId: debugDevice } : {}),
    resultsAdUnitId: {
      android: readAdMobId('ADMOB_ANDROID_RESULTS_UNIT_ID', 'ad unit', isProduction),
      ios: readAdMobId('ADMOB_IOS_RESULTS_UNIT_ID', 'ad unit', isProduction),
    },
    tracksAdUnitId: {
      android: readAdMobId('ADMOB_ANDROID_TRACKS_UNIT_ID', 'ad unit', isProduction),
      ios: readAdMobId('ADMOB_IOS_TRACKS_UNIT_ID', 'ad unit', isProduction),
    },
  };
}

const ADMOB = readAdMobConfig();
```

```ts
// Reads the AdMob settings app.config.ts put in extra.admob for this platform. It never imports the SDK, so
// the web bundle and SponsorProvider stay free of it; the native card turns { isTest: true } into
// TestIds.NATIVE. A placement with no unit id outside a test build means the house card.
import Constants from 'expo-constants';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';

import type { SponsorPlacement } from './types/SponsorPlacement';

type UnitIds = { android?: string; ios?: string };
type AdMobExtra = {
  consentDebugDeviceId?: string;
  isTestAds?: boolean;
  resultsAdUnitId?: UnitIds;
  tracksAdUnitId?: UnitIds;
};

function readAdMobExtra(): AdMobExtra | null {
  const admob = (Constants.expoConfig?.extra as { admob?: unknown } | undefined)?.admob;
  return typeof admob === 'object' && admob !== null ? (admob as AdMobExtra) : null;
}

function readUnitId(units: UnitIds | undefined): string | null {
  const id = Platform.OS === 'ios' ? units?.ios : Platform.OS === 'android' ? units?.android : undefined;
  return typeof id === 'string' && id !== '' ? id : null;
}

export function readAdMobPlacement(placement: SponsorPlacement): { adUnitId: string } | { isTest: true } | null {
  const admob = readAdMobExtra();
  if (admob === null) return null;
  const adUnitId = readUnitId(placement === 'results' ? admob.resultsAdUnitId : admob.tracksAdUnitId);
  if (adUnitId !== null) return { adUnitId };
  return admob.isTestAds === true ? { isTest: true } : null;
}

export function isAdMobConfigured(): boolean {
  return readAdMobPlacement('results') !== null || readAdMobPlacement('tracks') !== null;
}

export function readConsentDebugDeviceId(): string | null {
  const id = readAdMobExtra()?.consentDebugDeviceId;
  return typeof id === 'string' && id !== '' ? id : null;
}
```

`eas.json`: in `development` (lines 4-8) add `"env": { "ADMOB_USE_TEST_IDS": "true" }`; in `preview` `env` (lines 9-11) add `"ADMOB_USE_TEST_IDS": "true"` beside `API_BASE_URL`. Internal builds must never request live ads (clicking one's own live ads breaks AdMob policy). `production` gets no AdMob keys in `eas.json`: the real ids are set as EAS environment variables of the `production` environment (plain-text visibility, they are public), like the RevenueCat and PostHog keys. Until they are, a `production` build stops at config load with the first missing variable's name, by design.

`components/sponsor/__tests__/mobileAdsMock.ts`:

```ts
// The shared stand-in for react-native-google-mobile-ads, installed for every suite by jest.setup.ts.
// Consent and initialisation resolve or reject as mobileAdsControl says, and every SDK call is logged in
// order. useNativeAd behaves like the real hook: it requests only while autoLoad is true, keeps the ad
// deliverAd hands it, and destroys that ad on unmount (or at once when it arrives after unmount).
// NativeAdView and NativeAsset render plain views with test ids, so a suite can check what each asset wraps.
import { createElement, useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { View } from 'react-native';

type Step = 'resolve' | 'reject';

export type FakeNativeAd = {
  addAdEventListener: jest.Mock;
  body: string;
  callToAction: string;
  destroy: jest.Mock;
  headline: string;
  icon?: { url: string };
  listeners: Map<string, () => void>;
};

export const AdsConsentDebugGeography = { DISABLED: 0, EEA: 1, NOT_EEA: 2 } as const;
export const AdsConsentPrivacyOptionsRequirementStatus = {
  NOT_REQUIRED: 'NOT_REQUIRED',
  REQUIRED: 'REQUIRED',
  UNKNOWN: 'UNKNOWN',
} as const;
export const NativeAdChoicesPlacement = { BOTTOM_LEFT: 3, BOTTOM_RIGHT: 2, TOP_LEFT: 0, TOP_RIGHT: 1 } as const;
export const NativeAdEventType = { CLICKED: 'clicked', IMPRESSION: 'impression', PAID: 'paid' } as const;
export const NativeAssetType = {
  BODY: 'body',
  CALL_TO_ACTION: 'callToAction',
  HEADLINE: 'headline',
  ICON: 'icon',
} as const;
export const TestIds = { NATIVE: 'ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/3986624511' } as const;

export const mobileAdsControl = {
  calls: [] as string[],
  canRequestAds: true,
  form: 'resolve' as Step,
  infoUpdate: 'resolve' as Step,
  initialize: 'resolve' as Step,
  lastInfoUpdateOptions: undefined as unknown,
  pendingLoads: [] as ((outcome: FakeNativeAd | Error) => void)[],
  privacyOptionsStatus: 'NOT_REQUIRED' as keyof typeof AdsConsentPrivacyOptionsRequirementStatus,
  requests: [] as { adUnitId: string; options: Record<string, unknown> }[],
};

export function resetMobileAds(): void {
  Object.assign(mobileAdsControl, {
    calls: [],
    canRequestAds: true,
    form: 'resolve',
    infoUpdate: 'resolve',
    initialize: 'resolve',
    lastInfoUpdateOptions: undefined,
    pendingLoads: [],
    privacyOptionsStatus: 'NOT_REQUIRED',
    requests: [],
  });
}

export function buildFakeNativeAd(overrides: Partial<FakeNativeAd> = {}): FakeNativeAd {
  const listeners = new Map<string, () => void>();
  return {
    addAdEventListener: jest.fn((type: string, listener: () => void) => {
      listeners.set(type, listener);
      return { remove: () => listeners.delete(type) };
    }),
    body: 'Ship Postgres branches with every pull request.',
    callToAction: 'Install',
    destroy: jest.fn(),
    headline: 'Test Ad: Branching Postgres',
    icon: { url: 'https://example.test/icon.png' },
    listeners,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

// Answers the oldest pending ad request with an ad or an error (an Error stands for no fill).
export function deliverAd(outcome: FakeNativeAd | Error): void {
  const load = mobileAdsControl.pendingLoads.shift();
  if (!load) throw new Error('no ad request is pending');
  load(outcome);
}

function consentInfo() {
  return {
    canRequestAds: mobileAdsControl.canRequestAds,
    privacyOptionsRequirementStatus: mobileAdsControl.privacyOptionsStatus,
    status: 'OBTAINED',
  };
}

function settleStep<T>(step: Step, value: T): Promise<T> {
  return step === 'resolve' ? Promise.resolve(value) : Promise.reject(new Error('fake SDK failure'));
}

function useNativeAd(adUnitId: string, options: Record<string, unknown> & { autoLoad?: boolean } = {}) {
  const { autoLoad = true } = options;
  const [nativeAd, setNativeAd] = useState<FakeNativeAd | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<Error | null>(null);
  const adRef = useRef<FakeNativeAd | null>(null);
  const optionsRef = useRef(options);
  optionsRef.current = options;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!autoLoad) return undefined;
    let isMounted = true;
    mobileAdsControl.calls.push(`useNativeAd ${adUnitId}`);
    mobileAdsControl.requests.push({ adUnitId, options: optionsRef.current });
    mobileAdsControl.pendingLoads.push((outcome) => {
      if (outcome instanceof Error) {
        if (isMounted) setError(outcome);
        return;
      }
      if (!isMounted) {
        outcome.destroy();
        return;
      }
      adRef.current = outcome;
      setNativeAd(outcome);
    });
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      adRef.current?.destroy();
      adRef.current = null;
    };
  }, [adUnitId, autoLoad]);
  const status = error ? 'error' : nativeAd ? 'loaded' : autoLoad ? 'loading' : 'idle';
  return { destroy: () => adRef.current?.destroy(), error, nativeAd, retry: jest.fn(), status };
}

function NativeAdView({ children }: { children: ReactNode; nativeAd: unknown }) {
  return createElement(View, { testID: 'native-ad-view' }, children);
}

function NativeAsset({ assetType, children }: { assetType: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return createElement(View, { testID: `native-asset-${assetType}` }, children);
}

const mobileAds = () => ({
  initialize: jest.fn(() => {
    mobileAdsControl.calls.push('initialize');
    return settleStep(mobileAdsControl.initialize, []);
  }),
});

export const mobileAdsModule = {
  __esModule: true,
  default: mobileAds,
  AdsConsent: {
    getConsentInfo: jest.fn(() => {
      mobileAdsControl.calls.push('getConsentInfo');
      return Promise.resolve(consentInfo());
    }),
    loadAndShowConsentFormIfRequired: jest.fn(() => {
      mobileAdsControl.calls.push('loadAndShowConsentFormIfRequired');
      return settleStep(mobileAdsControl.form, consentInfo());
    }),
    requestInfoUpdate: jest.fn((options?: unknown) => {
      mobileAdsControl.calls.push('requestInfoUpdate');
      mobileAdsControl.lastInfoUpdateOptions = options;
      return settleStep(mobileAdsControl.infoUpdate, consentInfo());
    }),
    showPrivacyOptionsForm: jest.fn(() => {
      mobileAdsControl.calls.push('showPrivacyOptionsForm');
      return Promise.resolve(consentInfo());
    }),
  },
  AdsConsentDebugGeography,
  AdsConsentPrivacyOptionsRequirementStatus,
  NativeAdChoicesPlacement,
  NativeAdEventType,
  NativeAdView,
  NativeAsset,
  NativeAssetType,
  NativeMediaView: () => null,
  TestIds,
  useNativeAd,
};
```

`clients/adsConsentClient.ts`:

```ts
// The one module that talks to Google's consent (UMP) and Mobile Ads SDKs on iOS and Android, so
// SponsorProvider has one seam (the web build uses adsConsentClient.web.ts). It asks for consent where the
// user's region needs it, then initialises the SDK whatever the answer: requests are non-personalised, so a
// declined form still allows limited ads (Review Focus 8). Every failure is logged and swallowed; the result
// says whether ads may be requested and whether Settings must offer the privacy options form.
import mobileAds, {
  AdsConsent,
  AdsConsentDebugGeography,
  AdsConsentPrivacyOptionsRequirementStatus,
} from 'react-native-google-mobile-ads';

import { logWarning } from './logClient';

export type AdsConsentResult = { canRequestAds: boolean; privacyOptionsRequired: boolean };

type ConsentInfo = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof AdsConsent.getConsentInfo>>;

function toResult(info: ConsentInfo | null): AdsConsentResult {
  return {
    canRequestAds: info?.canRequestAds === true,
    privacyOptionsRequired:
      info?.privacyOptionsRequirementStatus === AdsConsentPrivacyOptionsRequirementStatus.REQUIRED,
  };
}

export async function gatherConsentAndInitialize({
  debugDeviceId,
}: {
  debugDeviceId: string | null;
}): Promise<AdsConsentResult> {
  try {
    await AdsConsent.requestInfoUpdate(
      debugDeviceId === null
        ? undefined
        : { debugGeography: AdsConsentDebugGeography.EEA, testDeviceIdentifiers: [debugDeviceId] },
    );
    await AdsConsent.loadAndShowConsentFormIfRequired();
  } catch (err) {
    logWarning({ err }, 'ads consent flow failed');
  }
  const info = await AdsConsent.getConsentInfo().catch((err: unknown) => {
    logWarning({ err }, 'ads consent info unavailable');
    return null;
  });
  try {
    await mobileAds().initialize();
  } catch (err) {
    logWarning({ err }, 'ads SDK failed to initialise');
    return { canRequestAds: false, privacyOptionsRequired: false };
  }
  return toResult(info);
}

export async function showAdsPrivacyOptions(): Promise<AdsConsentResult | null> {
  try {
    return toResult(await AdsConsent.showPrivacyOptionsForm());
  } catch (err) {
    logWarning({ err }, 'ads privacy options form failed');
    return null;
  }
}
```

`state/SponsorProvider.tsx` (replace the Task 6.3 file):

```tsx
// Decides once for the whole app whether sponsored cards may render, and prepares native ads. Cards render
// only after auth has hydrated and Pro status is known, and only for a user who is not Pro (a guest never
// is); while Pro status loads or after it fails every card stays hidden, so a Pro user never sees a flash
// (Review Focus 6). On iOS and Android, once a user may see cards in a build with AdMob ids, it runs the
// consent flow once and initialises the SDK whatever the answer (Review Focus 8); ads load only when the SDK
// allows requests, and otherwise cards fall back to house content. A Pro user and the web build never touch
// the SDK. Outside the provider every card is hidden. Mounted inside AuthProvider in app/_layout.tsx.
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';

import { Platform } from 'react-native';

import { gatherConsentAndInitialize, showAdsPrivacyOptions, type AdsConsentResult } from '../clients/adsConsentClient';
import { isAdMobConfigured, readConsentDebugDeviceId } from '../services/sponsor/readAdMobConfig';

import { useAuth } from './AuthProvider';
import { type ProStatusState, useProStatus } from './useProStatus';

export type SponsorEligibility = 'eligible' | 'hidden';
export type AdsStatus = 'pending' | 'ready' | 'unavailable';

type SponsorContextValue = {
  adsStatus: AdsStatus;
  eligibility: SponsorEligibility;
  isReady: boolean;
  privacyOptionsRequired: boolean;
  showPrivacyOptions: () => Promise<void>;
};

const HIDDEN: SponsorContextValue = {
  adsStatus: 'unavailable',
  eligibility: 'hidden',
  isReady: false,
  privacyOptionsRequired: false,
  showPrivacyOptions: () => Promise.resolve(),
};
const SponsorContext = createContext<SponsorContextValue>(HIDDEN);

export function readSponsorEligibility(proStatus: ProStatusState, isAuthHydrated: boolean): SponsorEligibility {
  if (!isAuthHydrated) return 'hidden';
  if (proStatus.status === 'guest') return 'eligible';
  if (proStatus.status === 'ready' && !proStatus.isPro) return 'eligible';
  return 'hidden';
}

function canUseNativeAds(): boolean {
  return Platform.OS !== 'web' && isAdMobConfigured();
}

export function SponsorProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const proStatus = useProStatus();
  const { isHydrated } = useAuth();
  const eligibility = readSponsorEligibility(proStatus, isHydrated);
  const [adsStatus, setAdsStatus] = useState<AdsStatus>(() => (canUseNativeAds() ? 'pending' : 'unavailable'));
  const [privacyOptionsRequired, setPrivacyOptionsRequired] = useState(false);
  const hasStarted = useRef(false);
  const isMounted = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMounted.current = true;
    return () => {
      isMounted.current = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const applyResult = useCallback((result: AdsConsentResult) => {
    if (!isMounted.current) return;
    setAdsStatus(result.canRequestAds ? 'ready' : 'unavailable');
    setPrivacyOptionsRequired(result.privacyOptionsRequired);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (eligibility !== 'eligible' || hasStarted.current || !canUseNativeAds()) return;
    hasStarted.current = true;
    void gatherConsentAndInitialize({ debugDeviceId: readConsentDebugDeviceId() }).then(applyResult);
  }, [applyResult, eligibility]);

  const showPrivacyOptions = useCallback(async () => {
    const result = await showAdsPrivacyOptions();
    if (result !== null) applyResult(result);
  }, [applyResult]);

  const value = useMemo<SponsorContextValue>(
    () => ({ adsStatus, eligibility, isReady: adsStatus === 'ready', privacyOptionsRequired, showPrivacyOptions }),
    [adsStatus, eligibility, privacyOptionsRequired, showPrivacyOptions],
  );
  return <SponsorContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</SponsorContext.Provider>;
}

export function useSponsor(): SponsorContextValue {
  return useContext(SponsorContext);
}
```

```tsx
const CONTENT_BASE_URL = 'https://example.test/content/';
const UNIT_ID = 'ca-app-pub-1234567890123456/1234567890';
const BASE_ADMOB = { androidAppId: 'a', iosAppId: 'i', isTestAds: false, resultsAdUnitId: {}, tracksAdUnitId: {} };

function setSponsor(adsStatus: 'pending' | 'ready' | 'unavailable') {
  mockSponsor.current = {
    adsStatus,
    eligibility: 'eligible',
    isReady: adsStatus === 'ready',
    privacyOptionsRequired: false,
    showPrivacyOptions: () => Promise.resolve(),
  };
}

function setAdMob(admob: Record<string, unknown>) {
  setExpoExtra({ admob, contentBaseUrl: CONTENT_BASE_URL });
}

const queryClient = createQueryClient();

function Card({ onShown }: { onShown?: () => void }) {
  return (
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
      <SponsoredCard placement="results" onShown={onShown} />
    </QueryClientProvider>
  );
}

function hostDescendants(node: ReactTestInstance): string[] {
  return node
    .findAll((candidate: ReactTestInstance) => candidate !== node && typeof candidate.type === 'string')
    .map((candidate) => candidate.type as string);
}

beforeEach(() => {
  resetMobileAds();
  queryClient.clear();
  setSponsor('ready');
  setAdMob({ ...BASE_ADMOB, resultsAdUnitId: { ios: UNIT_ID } });
});

afterAll(() => setExpoExtra({ contentBaseUrl: CONTENT_BASE_URL }));

describe('SponsoredCard with AdMob on native', () => {
  it('requests one non-personalised native ad with AdChoices top right and shows nothing while it loads', async () => {
    await render(<Card />);
    expect(mobileAdsControl.requests).toEqual([
      {
        adUnitId: UNIT_ID,
        options: expect.objectContaining({
          adChoicesPlacement: NativeAdChoicesPlacement.TOP_RIGHT,
          autoLoad: true,
          requestNonPersonalizedAdsOnly: true,
        }),
      },
    ]);
    expect(screen.queryByText('Sponsored')).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByText('Syntactical Pro')).toBeNull();
    expect(mockTrackEvent).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('wraps each asset, and only that view, in the matching NativeAsset', async () => {
    await render(<Card />);
    const ad = buildFakeNativeAd();
    await act(async () => deliverAd(ad));
    expect(screen.getByTestId('native-ad-view')).toBeTruthy();
    for (const [assetType, text] of [
      [NativeAssetType.HEADLINE, ad.headline],
      [NativeAssetType.BODY, ad.body],
      [NativeAssetType.CALL_TO_ACTION, ad.callToAction],
    ]) {
      const asset = screen.getByTestId(`native-asset-${assetType}`);
      expect(hostDescendants(asset)).toEqual(['Text']);
      expect(screen.getByText(text)).toBeTruthy();
    }
    expect(hostDescendants(screen.getByTestId(`native-asset-${NativeAssetType.ICON}`))).toEqual(['Image']);
    expect(screen.getByText(ad.body).props.numberOfLines).toBe(1);
    expect(screen.queryAllByRole('button')).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: `Sponsored: ${ad.headline}. Install` })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('keeps the Sponsored label first in the card', async () => {
    await render(<Card />);
    await act(async () => deliverAd(buildFakeNativeAd()));
    const card = screen.getByTestId('sponsored-card');
    const firstHost = card.findAll((node: ReactTestInstance) => node !== card && typeof node.type === 'string')[0];
    expect(firstHost).toBe(screen.getByText('Sponsored'));
  });

  it('reports ad_shown with source admob once the ad has rendered, and tells the host once', async () => {
    const onShown = jest.fn();
    await render(<Card onShown={onShown} />);
    expect(onShown).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    await act(async () => deliverAd(buildFakeNativeAd()));
    expect(mockTrackEvent.mock.calls).toEqual([['ad_shown', { placement: 'results', source: 'admob' }]]);
    expect(onShown).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('reports ad_clicked with source admob when the SDK reports a click', async () => {
    await render(<Card />);
    const ad = buildFakeNativeAd();
    await act(async () => deliverAd(ad));
    await act(async () => ad.listeners.get(NativeAdEventType.CLICKED)?.());
    expect(mockTrackEvent).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith('ad_clicked', { placement: 'results', source: 'admob' });
  });

  it('leaves out the icon asset when the ad has no icon', async () => {
    await render(<Card />);
    await act(async () => deliverAd(buildFakeNativeAd({ icon: undefined })));
    expect(screen.queryByTestId(`native-asset-${NativeAssetType.ICON}`)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('shows the house card when no ad is served', async () => {
    await render(<Card />);
    await act(async () => deliverAd(new Error('No fill')));
    expect(screen.getByText('Syntactical Pro')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(mockTrackEvent.mock.calls).toEqual([['ad_shown', { placement: 'results', source: 'house' }]]);
  });

  it('shows the house card at once and requests nothing when ads are unavailable', async () => {
    setSponsor('unavailable');
    await render(<Card />);
    expect(mobileAdsControl.requests).toEqual([]);
    expect(screen.getByText('Syntactical Pro')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('waits for consent before requesting, then requests once', async () => {
    setSponsor('pending');
    const view = await render(<Card />);
    expect(mobileAdsControl.requests).toEqual([]);
    expect(screen.queryByText('Sponsored')).toBeNull();
    setSponsor('ready');
    view.rerender(<Card />);
    await settle();
    expect(mobileAdsControl.requests).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('destroys an ad that arrives after unmount, reports nothing, and updates no state', async () => {
    const consoleError = jest.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => undefined);
    const view = await render(<Card />);
    view.unmount();
    const ad = buildFakeNativeAd();
    await act(async () => deliverAd(ad));
    expect(ad.destroy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockTrackEvent).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(consoleError).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    consoleError.mockRestore();
  });

  it('destroys a shown ad when the card unmounts', async () => {
    const view = await render(<Card />);
    const ad = buildFakeNativeAd();
    await act(async () => deliverAd(ad));
    view.unmount();
    expect(ad.destroy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("uses Google's test unit in a test build without unit ids", async () => {
    setAdMob({ ...BASE_ADMOB, isTestAds: true });
    await render(<Card />);
    expect(mobileAdsControl.requests[0]?.adUnitId).toBe(TestIds.NATIVE);
  });

  it('shows the house card and requests nothing without unit ids outside a test build', async () => {
    setAdMob(BASE_ADMOB);
    await render(<Card />);
    expect(mobileAdsControl.requests).toEqual([]);
    expect(screen.getByText('Syntactical Pro')).toBeTruthy();
  });
});
```

`components/sponsor/SponsoredCard.tsx` (replace the Task 6.4 file):

```tsx
// The sponsored card on iOS and Android (the web build uses SponsoredCard.web.tsx). Renders nothing unless
// SponsorProvider allows cards. With an AdMob unit for the placement (Google's test unit in a test build),
// it loads one non-personalised native ad per card mount, once consent allows, with the AdChoices icon top
// right, and renders it in the card frame: each asset a bare Text or Image directly inside its NativeAsset,
// no touchable wrappers and no media view. Nothing shows while consent or the ad is pending. No unit id,
// ads unavailable, or a load error (no fill) shows the direct sponsor or the house card. The hook owns the
// ad and destroys it on unmount, so an ad that arrives after the screen left reports nothing (Review
// Focus 7). ad_shown is reported after the ad has rendered; ad_clicked on the SDK's click event.
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { Image, Text } from 'react-native';
import {
  NativeAdChoicesPlacement,
  NativeAdEventType,
  NativeAdView,
  NativeAsset,
  NativeAssetType,
  TestIds,
  useNativeAd,
} from 'react-native-google-mobile-ads';

import { readAdMobPlacement } from '../../services/sponsor/readAdMobConfig';
import type { SponsorPlacement } from '../../services/sponsor/types/SponsorPlacement';
import { useSponsor } from '../../state/SponsorProvider';

import { SPONSOR_CLASSES, SponsoredCardFrame } from './SponsoredCardFrame';
import { SponsorContentSlot } from './SponsorContentSlot';
import { useSponsorContent, type SponsorContentState } from './useSponsorContent';

export type SponsoredCardProps = { onShown?: () => void; placement: SponsorPlacement };

const FALLBACK_CALL_TO_ACTION = 'Open';

function resolveAdUnitId(placement: SponsorPlacement): string | null {
  const unit = readAdMobPlacement(placement);
  if (unit === null) return null;
  return 'adUnitId' in unit ? unit.adUnitId : TestIds.NATIVE;
}

function AdMobCard({ adUnitId, sponsor }: { adUnitId: string; sponsor: SponsorContentState }) {
  const { adsStatus } = useSponsor();
  const options = useMemo(
    () => ({
      adChoicesPlacement: NativeAdChoicesPlacement.TOP_RIGHT,
      autoLoad: adsStatus === 'ready',
      requestNonPersonalizedAdsOnly: true,
    }),
    [adsStatus],
  );
  const { error, nativeAd } = useNativeAd(adUnitId, options);
  const { onClicked, onShown } = sponsor;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (nativeAd === null || nativeAd === undefined) return undefined;
    onShown('admob');
    const subscription = nativeAd.addAdEventListener(NativeAdEventType.CLICKED, () => onClicked('admob'));
    return () => subscription.remove();
  }, [nativeAd, onClicked, onShown]);

  if (adsStatus === 'unavailable' || error) return <SponsorContentSlot sponsor={sponsor} />;
  if (!nativeAd) return null;

  const { body, callToAction, headline, icon } = nativeAd;
  const actionLabel = callToAction || FALLBACK_CALL_TO_ACTION;
  const iconAsset = icon ? (
    <NativeAsset assetType={NativeAssetType.ICON}>
      <Image aria-hidden source={{ uri: icon.url }} className={SPONSOR_CLASSES.icon} />
    </NativeAsset>
  ) : undefined;
  return (
    <NativeAdView nativeAd={nativeAd}>
      <SponsoredCardFrame headline={headline} icon={iconAsset}>
        <NativeAsset assetType={NativeAssetType.HEADLINE}>
          <Text className={SPONSOR_CLASSES.headline}>{headline}</Text>
        </NativeAsset>
        {body ? (
          <NativeAsset assetType={NativeAssetType.BODY}>
            <Text numberOfLines={1} className={SPONSOR_CLASSES.body}>
              {body}
            </Text>
          </NativeAsset>
        ) : null}
        <NativeAsset assetType={NativeAssetType.CALL_TO_ACTION}>
          <Text
            role="link"
            aria-label={`Sponsored: ${headline}. ${actionLabel}`}
            className={SPONSOR_CLASSES.actionText}
          >
            {actionLabel}
          </Text>
        </NativeAsset>
      </SponsoredCardFrame>
    </NativeAdView>
  );
}

function NativeSponsoredCard({ onShown, placement }: SponsoredCardProps) {
  const sponsor = useSponsorContent(placement, onShown);
  const [adUnitId] = useState(() => resolveAdUnitId(placement));
  if (adUnitId === null) return <SponsorContentSlot sponsor={sponsor} />;
  return <AdMobCard adUnitId={adUnitId} sponsor={sponsor} />;
}

export function SponsoredCard(props: SponsoredCardProps) {
  const { eligibility } = useSponsor();
  if (eligibility === 'hidden') return null;
  return <NativeSponsoredCard {...props} />;
}
```

(Check the SDK's exact type names at implementation: the icon field (`icon.url`), the event subscription's `remove()`, and whether `NativeAdView` needs the asset `Text` to have no `numberOfLines`. If a name differs, change this file and the shared mock together, never the RED test's behaviour.)

```markdown
- sponsored card: the one card free users see after the results screen's Retry and Menu row or between the track groups, in the app's own card style with a "Sponsored" label (`components/sponsor/SponsoredCard.tsx`, `SponsoredCard.web.tsx`). ### Open questions (area 6)
```

1. **EthicalAds no-fill detection.** The client documents no "no ad" callback. Assumption: a placement with no child element 3 seconds after `load()` or `reload()` is no fill (`hasFill` in `SponsoredCard.web.tsx`). Verify on the deployed site once a publisher id exists (an unapproved or unfilled placement), and tighten to `.ea-content` if the client adds other children.
2. **App ids in a build without AdMob ids.** Decided rule (Task 6.13): the SDK refuses to start without an app id once the library is linked, so `development`, `preview`, and local builds (and the web export) without the variables carry Google's sample app ids and request nothing unless they are test builds (no unit ids means the house card). A production build never carries Google's ids: when `EAS_BUILD_PROFILE` is `production`, `app.config.ts` throws, naming the variable and never the value, if any of the two app ids or four ad unit ids is missing or starts with Google's sample and test publisher `ca-app-pub-3940256099942544`, or if `ADMOB_USE_TEST_IDS` is `true`. So no production store build can be made until the owner sets the six real ids in the EAS `production` environment. To confirm at the first production build: that the config `eas build` reads (locally and on the worker) sees `EAS_BUILD_PROFILE` and the `production` environment's variables; if the local read lacks the variables, the build stops early with a variable's name, which is the intended failure, not a leak.
3. **Unit ids per platform.** `extra.admob.resultsAdUnitId` and `tracksAdUnitId` are `{ android, ios }` objects rather than single strings, because one config serves both platforms and the spec asks for four units.
4. **Production AdMob variables.** Kept out of `eas.json` and set as EAS `production` environment variables (like the RevenueCat and PostHog keys); `eas.json` carries only `ADMOB_USE_TEST_IDS=true` for `development` and `preview`.
5. **SDK details to confirm against 17.4.0 at implementation.** `useNativeAd`'s `status` values (the card reads `nativeAd` and `error`, not `status`), the native ad's `icon.url` field, the event subscription's `remove()`, the exact `AdsConsentDebugGeography` and `NativeAssetType` values (the mock uses its own), and whether `useNativeAd` re-requests on a new options object (the card memoises it). Change the card and the shared mock together if a name differs.
6. **SKAdNetwork list.** Only Google's own id (`cstr6suwn9.skadnetwork`) is written out; the implementer copies the full list from the plugin's README.
7. **Device ID on the store forms.** Whether the Mobile Ads SDK collects a device identifier for non-personalised requests (Android AAID, iOS IDFV) is taken from Google's SDK disclosure at submission time; Task 6.16 marks those rows "confirm".
8. **Shapes from other areas.** Aligned with area 4: `ProStatusState` (Task 4.1, `ready` is `{ status: 'ready' } & ProStatus`), `ProSheet`'s props and `ProSheetSource` (Task 4.3, which already includes `'house_card'`), `ProOffer` (Task 4.7) as the signed-in buy flow, and `PurchasesState` with `BuyOutcome` unchanged (Task 4.5); every area 6 stand-in has those shapes. A `Pro status error` is treated as hidden (a paying user offline never sees a card; a free user offline sees none either). Remaining gaps: (a) `ProOffer` renders nothing for a guest, so the house card's guest path is area 6's own bare `ProSheet` plus a sign-in redirect (`SponsorProSheetHost`), not an area 4 component; if area 4 later serves guests in `ProOffer`, the host collapses to `ProOffer` alone. (b) Area 4's open question 6 assumes the results-screen footer Pro entry point (`ProSheetSource` `'results'`) belongs to this area; no task in area 6 builds it, and the results card here opens the sheet with `'house_card'` only.
9. **`app/+html.tsx` script line.** Aligned with area 5's Task 5.4: Task 6.11 quotes its import, constant, publisher read, and `{ethicalAdsPublisher === null ? null : <script async src={ETHICAL_ADS_SCRIPT} />}` line, and replaces them with `<EthicalAdsScript />`; the only output change is `async` to `defer`, and area 5's `htmlShell.web.test.tsx` passes unchanged. Whether `expo-constants` resolves `extra` during static rendering is still assumed (area 5's open question 7 makes the same assumption; if it does not, both files leave the script out).
10. **Route-change reload.** Screens are swapped by `Slot`, so a card rarely survives a route change; `reload()` fires only while a placement stays mounted, and a card that fell back to house content stays on it for that mount.

## Area 7: crawlable pages (`feat/crawlable-pages`)

Risk: standard. Depends on: areas 1 and 2 (all 36 banks under `content/`) and area 5 (`web.output: 'static'`, `generateStaticParams` on both menu routes, `state/useIsHydrated.ts`, `scripts/writeHostFiles.mjs`). After launch; nothing else waits on it. Branch: `feat/crawlable-pages`.

What this area assumes from area 5, checked before Task 7.1 starts:

- `state/useIsHydrated.ts` exports `useIsHydrated(): boolean`, false during the static render and the first client render, true after mount.
- `scripts/writeHostFiles.mjs` exports `writeHostFiles(outputDir)`, run by `npm run build` from the repository root after `expo export`.

Area 5 did not change `ContentProvider`: it still returns `null` until its AsyncStorage read finishes (Task 5.1's audit records this), so every static page has an empty body. Task 7.1 changes that before anything else in this area; without it the text Tasks 7.3 and 7.4 add never reaches `dist`.

Run `git show origin/main:state/useIsHydrated.ts` and `git show origin/main:scripts/writeHostFiles.mjs` first. If either export has another name or signature, use that name in Tasks 7.3 to 7.5 and record the change in the PR description.

Design decisions for the area:

- **Where the titles come from.** Only Easy banks are bundled, so the bank pages cannot read Medium and Hard titles from the app bundle. `scripts/buildBankTitles.mjs` reads every bank file under `content/` in Node and writes `services/content/bankTitles.generated.ts`. That module is the only source of the page text.
- **Why `content:build` and not `build`.** The generated module is imported by app code, so `npx tsc --noEmit` and Jest need it committed. `content:build` is the script that regenerates the other committed generated files, and it is the one the CI drift check runs. `build` runs `content:build` first, so the web export always sees fresh titles.
- **Distinct titles.** A bank repeats broad titles: `content/python/easy.json` has 104 questions and 72 distinct titles. A list with repeated lines is thin content, so the index keeps each title once, at its first position. The bank size comes from a separate count.
- **Bundled content first.** `ContentProvider` serves `BUNDLED_MANIFEST` and the bundled banks from its first render and switches to the cached content once AsyncStorage has been read. It marks the gap with its own `isHydrated` flag on the context, not with `useIsHydrated`: the component mounts before the read resolves, so the mount flag would claim cached content that has not been read yet. The static render and the first client render both see the bundled content, so they produce the same tree.
- **Native.** Native builds have no static export, and `useIsHydrated` is false on their first render too. `TrackSummary.native.tsx` and `BankTitles.native.tsx` render nothing, which keeps the title index out of the native bundles and stops a one-frame flash of the summary.

### Task 7.1: ContentProvider renders the bundled content before storage is read

**Files:**

- Modify: `state/ContentProvider.tsx` (header comment, lines 1-4; the constants, lines 24-25; `buildContentAccess`, lines 69-77; `ContentProvider`, lines 79-105)
- Modify: `services/content/types/ContentAccess.ts` (header comment, lines 1-3; the type, lines 6-10)
- Modify: `state/useQuestionBank.ts` (as area 2's Task 2.6 left it: the header comment, the query's `enabled` line, and the first status return)
- Modify: `services/content/__tests__/prefetchChangedBanks.test.ts` (the `ContentAccess` literal in `buildAccess`, line 52 today)
- Test: `state/__tests__/ContentProviderBundledFirst.test.tsx` (new)

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes: `BUNDLED_MANIFEST`, `readBundledBank` (inside the provider), `hydrateContent()` (unchanged), and the fixtures in `services/content/__tests__/fixtures/contentFixtures.ts`.
- Produces: `ContentAccess` gains `isHydrated: boolean`, false until the provider has read the cached manifest and banks (or the read failed), true after. `ContentProvider` never renders `null`: until the read finishes it renders its children with `baselineManifest: BUNDLED_MANIFEST` and a `readLocalBank` that serves only the bundled banks, the same values its catch branch already falls back to (`{ banks: new Map(), manifest: BUNDLED }`, with `readLocalBank` falling through to `readBundledBank`). `useQuestionBank` returns `{ status: 'loading' }` (or `ready` with a bundled bank) while `isHydrated` is false, never `unknown` or `error`, and starts no download.

Why the provider's own flag and not `useIsHydrated` (area 5): the provider mounts before AsyncStorage answers, so the mount flag turns true while the cached content is still unread. The static render and the first client render both have `hydrated === null`, so both use the bundled values and produce the same tree.

The manifest refresh and the changed-bank prefetch still wait for the cache read (today they wait for `access !== null`, which meant the same thing). `useReviewQueue` reads `readLocalBank` and sees only bundled banks until the read; it rebuilds when the context value changes, and the stats event log it needs is empty until `StatsProvider` hydrates anyway.

```tsx
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { QueryClientProvider, type QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';

let queryClient: QueryClient;

// The manifest a returning visitor has cached: a newer Python Easy content version and one more
// track, so both the version and the language ids tell it apart from the bundled one.
function buildCachedManifest(): Manifest {
  const manifest = cloneBundledManifest();
  const pythonEasy = manifest.languages[0].banks.easy!;
  manifest.languages[0].banks.easy = { ...pythonEasy, contentVersion: pythonEasy.contentVersion + 1 };
  manifest.languages.push(buildAddedLanguage(hashUtf8Hex(ADDED_EASY_TEXT)) as never);
  return manifest;
}

function ManifestProbe() {

      <Text testID="language-ids">{languages.map(({ id }) => id).join(',')}</Text>
      <Text testID="python-easy-version">{String(languages[0].banks.easy?.contentVersion)}</Text>
    </>
  );
}

function AddedBankProbe() {
  return <Text testID="added-bank-status">{useQuestionBank('fixture-lang', 'easy').status}</Text>;
}

function readText(testID: string): string {
  return String(screen.getByTestId(testID).props.children);
}

function renderProvider(contentBaseUrl: string | null, children: ReactNode) {
  return render(
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
      <ContentProvider contentBaseUrl={contentBaseUrl}>{children}</ContentProvider>
    </QueryClientProvider>,
  );
}

// Holds every AsyncStorage read until release(), so a test can look at the provider before the
// cache read resolves. restore() puts the mock's own getItem back.
function holdStorageReads() {
  let openGate: () => void = () => {};
  const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
    openGate = resolve;
  });
  const realGetItem = jest.mocked(AsyncStorage.getItem).getMockImplementation();
  const spy = jest.spyOn(AsyncStorage, 'getItem').mockImplementation(async (key: string) => {
    await gate;
    return realGetItem?.(key) ?? null;
  });
  return {
    release: () => act(async () => openGate()),
    restore: () => spy.mockImplementation(realGetItem),
  };
}

describe('ContentProvider before and after the cache read', () => {

    await AsyncStorage.clear();
    queryClient = createQueryClient();
```

```tsx
export function ContentProvider({ contentBaseUrl, children }: { contentBaseUrl: string | null; children: ReactNode }) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [hydrated, setHydrated] = useState<HydratedContent | null>(null);
  const isHydrated = hydrated !== null;

  useEffect(() => {
    hydrateContent()
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        logWarning({ err }, 'content hydration failed');
        return BUNDLED_CONTENT;
      })
      .then(setHydrated);
  }, []);

  const access = useMemo(
    () => buildContentAccess(hydrated ?? BUNDLED_CONTENT, contentBaseUrl, isHydrated),
    [hydrated, contentBaseUrl, isHydrated],
  );

  // The refresh waits for the cache read, so it compares against what the device holds.
  const { data: fetchedManifest } = useQuery(buildManifestQuery(contentBaseUrl, isHydrated));

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isHydrated && fetchedManifest) prefetchChangedBanks(queryClient, fetchedManifest, access);
  }, [access, fetchedManifest, isHydrated, queryClient]);

  return <ContentContext.Provider value={access}>{children}</ContentContext.Provider>;
}
```

`scripts/buildBankTitles.mjs`:

```js
// Build step for the crawlable bank pages: reads every bank the content manifest lists and writes
// services/content/bankTitles.generated.ts with each bank's question count and its distinct
// query.title values in bank order. Titles are written not to give answers away, so they are the
// only question text that leaves the bank files here: never prompts, choices, answers,
// explanations, rationales, or syntax. Runs inside `npm run content:build`, after the manifest.
import { isSafeBankPath } from '@syntactical/content-schema';
import { realpathSync } from 'node:fs';
import { readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

const GENERATED_HEADER = `// GENERATED by scripts/buildBankTitles.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
// Run \`npm run content:build\` to regenerate it.
`;

function listBanks(manifest) {
  return manifest.languages.flatMap((language) =>
    Object.entries(language.banks).map(([difficulty, bank]) => ({
      key: `${language.id}/${difficulty}`,
      path: bank.path,
    })),
  );
}

// Each title once, at its first position: a bank repeats broad titles across questions.
function listDistinctTitles(questions) {
  return [...new Set(questions.map((question) => question.query.title))];
}

async function readBankSummary(contentDir, bankPath) {
  if (!isSafeBankPath(bankPath)) throw new Error(`${bankPath} is not a safe bank path`);
  const bank = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(contentDir, bankPath), 'utf8'));
  return { questionCount: bank.questions.length, titles: listDistinctTitles(bank.questions) };
}

function renderSource(entries) {
  const sorted = [...entries].sort((left, right) => (left.key < right.key ? -1 : 1));
  const countLines = sorted.map(({ key, summary }) => `  ${JSON.stringify(key)}: ${summary.questionCount},`);
  const titleLines = sorted.map(({ key, summary }) => `  ${JSON.stringify(key)}: ${JSON.stringify(summary.titles)},`);
  return `${GENERATED_HEADER}
export const BANK_QUESTION_COUNTS: Readonly<Record<string, number>> = {
${countLines.join('\n')}
};

export const BANK_TITLES: Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>> = {
${titleLines.join('\n')}
};
`;
}

export async function buildBankTitles(contentDir, outputPath) {
  const manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(contentDir, 'manifest.json'), 'utf8'));
  const entries = await Promise.all(
    listBanks(manifest).map(async ({ key, path }) => ({ key, summary: await readBankSummary(contentDir, path) })),
  );
  await writeFile(outputPath, renderSource(entries));
  return entries.length;
}

// Compare as file URLs: a plain string compare breaks on a path with a space, and a symlink needs
// its real path.
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(realpathSync(process.argv[1])).href) {
  const repoDir = process.cwd();
  buildBankTitles(join(repoDir, 'content'), join(repoDir, 'services/content/bankTitles.generated.ts')).catch((err) => {
    console.error(err);
    process.exitCode = 1;
  });
}
```
